verdict: No material interpretive overclaim or blocker identified in the six public narratives.

assessment.assessment: The narratives identify seven underlying judgments per researcher, two Neel source groups and one Chris group. Ordered rows, configurations, caps and repeated schedules are not treated as independent human judgments. Canonical controls and historical aliases are disclosed as reused observations with nonadditive calls and charges.

assessment.boundary: Missingness and matched versus conditional comparisons
assessment.assessment: Planned denominators retain invalid, empty, unavailable and non-dispatched cells. Conditional valid accuracy and jointly valid paired comparisons are distinguished from operational delivered-correct performance. Richer-only and sparse-only delivery subsets and incomplete selected-family coverage are visible. Missing predictions are treated as operational nondelivery, without inferring that an unobserved choice would be wrong.

More text within unchanged source families is distinguished from broad new source coverage. Single extraction attempts, different request times, stochastic generation and service effects prevent causal attribution to writing volume. Generic answerability, public-source familiarity and source memorization remain competing explanations. The strong no-profile/name-only baseline limits discrimination.

Semantic reversal comparisons are described as retrieval-plus-consumer pipeline sensitivity because retrieved context can change. Exact-span changes are not asserted to imply semantic changes or cause accuracy flips. Lexical context invariance and semantic context variation are separately reported. Existing raw-evidence aliases are not promoted into a second independent capability measurement.

The reports mark the promoted subset and common-cap panel as exploratory development choices. Reuse of replicate0 outcomes, awareness of prior development results and separate richer-source conditions are explicit. Stable replication is not claimed to establish a general fidelity winner, personal-profile benefit, final-test performance or downstream utility.

assessment.status: Narrative qualifications are adequate; underlying empirical claims not re-audited here
assessment.assessment: Known usage, retained uncertainty, producer embedding costs and alias reuse are separated, with no invoice claim. Scoring, rendering and control-binding verification are attributed to their respective owners rather than presented as newly performed by this reviewer.
